tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground for every Mafia screen (arcade-black). Under the night-sky radial of night-navy at the top of the frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised panels: lobby room card, inputs behind text.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Solid cards when a gradient card is too heavy.

tokens.name: night-navy
tokens.usage: Top stop of every card gradient (candidate, role card, dawn card) and the night-sky radial over the page. Also the ink on the Village verdict.

tokens.name: night-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the card gradient: night-navy -> night-deep, 180deg.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim (exit confirm, tutorial).

tokens.name: surface-team
tokens.usage: Mafia-only surfaces: the night action card, the team chat row and the whisper panel. Paired with a mafia-red border.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, names, headlines on dark grounds (soft-white).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Sub-lines under titles, chat previews, helper copy. 7.6:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Pixel captions, inactive phase chips, timestamps. 3.5:1 on surface-page: FAILS 4.5:1 for small text (kept from source). Never use it for anything a player must read to act.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on light fills: the steel primary button, active chips.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Verdict headline and stat numbers on the Mafia-won screen.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines: inbox row dividers, idle candidate cards, inactive phase chips.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Ghost buttons, the face-down role card, section rule above the conversations.

tokens.name: mafia-red
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. The logo ink, night kickers, the Mafia role, kill targets, the face-down card's pulse. 4.7:1 on surface-page. Spend it on danger and on the Mafia only.

tokens.name: mafia-red-dim
tokens.usage: Mafia role-card bloom and the role reveal glow.

tokens.name: whisper-red
tokens.usage: Partner line inside the Mafia whisper panel (softer than mafia-red so it reads as speech, not alarm).

tokens.name: role-mafia
tokens.usage: Role colour: Mafia. Card border, role name, ring on whisper avatars, TARGET tag.

tokens.name: role-doctor
tokens.usage: Role colour: Doctor (surgical steel). PROTECTED tag, the 'Doctor saved a life' line.

tokens.name: role-doctor-dim
tokens.usage: Doctor role-card bloom.

tokens.name: role-sheriff
tokens.usage: Role colour: Sheriff/Detective (badge gold). SUSPECT tag, investigation result frame.

tokens.name: role-sheriff-dim
tokens.usage: Sheriff role-card bloom.

tokens.name: role-citizen
tokens.usage: Role colour: Citizen (paper white). On a light fill swap to night-navy text.

tokens.name: role-citizen-dim
tokens.usage: Citizen role-card bloom.

tokens.name: action-steel
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Begin night, Lock in my vote, Start the day) with text-on-accent. Noir's replacement for the platform's pixel-green.

tokens.name: info-steel
tokens.usage: Focus ring, unread thread bar and dot, links. Noir's replacement for cyber-cyan.

tokens.name: smoke-violet
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (rare). Noir's replacement for electric-purple.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: 'Hot' button (Play again after a Mafia win) and danger states. 3.3:1 against both surface-page and dark text: below 4.5:1, use only at 18px+ bold (kept from source).

tokens.name: phase-night
tokens.usage: Phase chip: NIGHT (moonlight).

tokens.name: phase-dawn
tokens.usage: Phase chip: DAWN (sunrise).

tokens.name: phase-day
tokens.usage: Phase chip: DAY (noon gold). Also the dawn kicker.

tokens.name: phase-vote
tokens.usage: Phase chip: VOTE (brick). 4.3:1 on surface-page, slightly under 4.5:1 at 9px (kept from source).

tokens.name: phase-verdict
tokens.usage: Phase chip: VERDICT (crimson).

tokens.name: alive-steady
tokens.usage: Alive counter while more than half the table lives.

tokens.name: alive-warm
tokens.usage: Alive counter past halfway.

tokens.name: alive-hot
tokens.usage: Alive counter in the last few; the heart icon starts pulsing.

tokens.name: chat-mine-fill
tokens.usage: Your own chat bubble fill (day chat, private threads).

tokens.name: chat-mine-border
tokens.usage: Your own chat bubble border.

tokens.name: chat-other-fill
tokens.usage: Everyone else's chat bubble fill.

tokens.name: ring-1
tokens.usage: Seat ring 1. Seats cycle ring-1..ring-7 by join order; the token icon sits inside.

tokens.name: ring-2
tokens.usage: Seat ring 2.

tokens.name: ring-3
tokens.usage: Seat ring 3 (gold, same as role-sheriff; the ring never implies a role).

tokens.name: ring-4
tokens.usage: Seat ring 4.

tokens.name: ring-5
tokens.usage: Seat ring 5.

tokens.name: ring-6
tokens.usage: Seat ring 6.

tokens.name: ring-7
tokens.usage: Seat ring 7.

tokens.name: verdict-mafia-glow
tokens.usage: Mafia-won verdict: radial centre (-> #0a0308 -> black).

tokens.name: verdict-mafia-ground
tokens.usage: Mafia-won verdict: radial mid stop.

tokens.name: verdict-dawn-sky
tokens.usage: Citizens-won verdict: sunrise centre of the sky radial.

tokens.name: verdict-dawn-mid
tokens.usage: Citizens-won verdict: sky mid stop.

tokens.name: verdict-dawn-low
tokens.usage: Citizens-won verdict: sky low stop, falling to night-navy.

tokens.name: verdict-dawn-ink
tokens.usage: Citizens-won verdict: headline ink on the bright sky.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Landing headline; clamp(48px,6vw,88px), 34-48px on phones. 'no one.' in mafia-red.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: Game-over headline, uppercase, max 14ch, clamp(38px,5.2vw,64px).

styles.name: report
styles.usage: Dawn report lines, uppercase.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: The one question a screen asks, uppercase.

styles.name: role-name
styles.usage: Role name on the revealed card and investigation result, uppercase, in the role colour.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Verdict stat numbers.

styles.name: victim
styles.usage: Name on the face-down dawn card, uppercase.

styles.name: phase-title
styles.usage: Phase bar title above the night and day, uppercase.

styles.name: alive-count
styles.usage: The live count in the alive counter (16px on phones).

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Large button label, uppercase; 18px 40px padding.

styles.name: button-md
styles.usage: Medium button label, uppercase; 12px 24px padding.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Small button label, uppercase; 8px 16px padding.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Secret roles. Whispered nights. Public accusations.
styles.usage: Landing sub-line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If the Mafia strikes your pick, they survive the night.
styles.usage: Default running text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Your role is secret. Don't show your screen.
styles.usage: Sub-lines under screen titles; role descriptions.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title inside the night action card.

styles.name: player-name
styles.usage: Names on candidate cards, winner pills, investigation lines.

styles.name: chat
styles.usage: Chat bubbles.

styles.name: chat-preview
styles.sample: I don't trust Reem. Too quiet.
styles.usage: Last line in an inbox row.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Quick-reply chips, small helper lines.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Eyebrow above a screen title; usually in mafia-red or a phase colour. Uppercase.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Phase clock in the phase bar.

styles.name: pixel-caption
styles.usage: Card labels, stat labels, win conditions.

styles.name: phase-chip
styles.usage: Phase strip chips.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags under candidates, speaker labels in chat. The smallest size in the game: never below 7px.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Every display and pixel style in Arabic: Readex Pro 700, line-height 1.25, no tracking, no uppercase.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Running text in Arabic.

styles.name: ar-label
styles.usage: Replaces Silkscreen labels in Arabic (line-height 1.4).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, composer input and Send.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inbox row gap; phase bar gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (action card); phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks on a screen; screen side padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Verdict section spacing.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen top/bottom padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Landing hero top space on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Phase chips, the MAFIA badge.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the alive counter.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Candidate cards, action card, whisper panel.

tokens.name: radius-inbox
tokens.usage: Conversation list, dawn card, open action panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Role card (face down and face up), investigation result.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Quick replies, winner pills, the 'you are' chip, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Modals.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control (info-steel ring).

tokens.name: glow-mafia
tokens.usage: Selected kill target.

tokens.name: glow-doctor
tokens.usage: Selected protection.

tokens.name: glow-sheriff
tokens.usage: Selected suspect.

tokens.name: glow-reveal
tokens.usage: Revealed role card bloom (Mafia shown; other roles use their -dim colour).

tokens.name: glow-red-pulse
tokens.usage: Peak of the face-down card's redPulse (2.6s loop).

tokens.name: glow-action
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. An arcade-green leftover the noir override does not reach: kept from source, flagged for review.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Button press and hover.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Chip and colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Screen fades.

tokens.usage: Springy overshoot for lifts, pops and the card flip.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Calm settles.
